state.goal: Choose the next discriminating evidence check among explicit alternatives; do not establish the bug or edit from this judgment.
state.scope: React issue reports react/react-dom 19.3.0; current default branch is separately pinned at 71f725593739d2cb5866a282a1075d581831722f.
state.reasoning: Observed: the issue reports that a nested ViewTransition rendered through a portal gets no name/class during a same-commit mount and cites an enter-prop sentence about a parent Component mounting. The issue has no comments. The v19.3.0 source has commitEnterViewTransitions, which applies a name/class when its placement is a ViewTransition. Current ReactFiberCommitWork says exactly: 'The first ViewTransition inside a newly mounted tree runs an enter transition but other nested ones don't unless they have a named pair.' This may indicate intentional semantics, a documentation mismatch, or a portal-only traversal gap. The exact public contract and release portal control flow remain unverified. I need a check that can falsify one of those explanations, not agreement with a preferred fix.

exactDecidingExcerpts.excerpt: Only the outer <ViewTransition> ... is activated ... The inner, nested <ViewTransition> ... never gets a view-transition-name or view-transition-class assigned.

if (placement.tag === ViewTransitionComponent) ... applyViewTransitionToHostInstances(placement, name, className, null, false) ... else if ((placement.subtreeFlags & ViewTransitionStatic) !== NoFlags) ... commitEnterViewTransitions(child, gesture).
The first ViewTransition inside a newly mounted tree runs an enter transition but other nested ones don't unless they have a named pair.

hypotheses.h1_contract_bug: The documented enter contract requires independent nested enter names/classes; first-only traversal violates it.
hypotheses.h2_intentional_semantics: Nested enters are intentionally suppressed; the report misreads or reveals ambiguous documentation, so no reconciler edit is safe.
hypotheses.h3_portal_gap: Portal after-mutation traversal uniquely fails to schedule an otherwise-supported nested entry.
hypotheses.none: The supplied evidence cannot yet select a useful direction.

unknowns: release test coverage for nested portal entries

candidateChecks.c1_contract_test: Read official ViewTransition enter documentation and v19.3.0 tests for nested/parent-mounted semantics; it separates a supported contract bug from intentional semantics.
candidateChecks.c2_portal_path: Read v19.3.0 HostPortal after-mutation traversal and contrast it with non-portal nested mounts; it separates a portal-only gap from generic first-only semantics.
candidateChecks.c3_release_regression_test: Locate the v19.3.0 ViewTransition test suite for nested and portal controls; it can distinguish all three but may be less direct.
candidateChecks.none: No supplied check is discriminating enough.
